description: A file of /etc/escouade/policies/*.json (root:root, 0644). Generated from crates/escouade-policy/src/list.rs: do not edit.

accounts.reservation.description: denied: no account is reserved to a project; a private project goes on the shared accounts, its fence keeps its sessions. required: a private project goes only on an account reserved to it alone, never on a shared account, even at the limit. denied: each account’s “Reserved to projects” emptied and grayed, “Reserve … to this project” and “Add a reserved account…” refused. required: “Shared accounts at the limit” off and grayed, “Stop reserving it” refused on the last account reserved to a private project, an agent of a private project refused on a shared account.
accounts.reservation.title: Account reservation

extensions.allowed.description: A JSON object like VS Code’s extensions.allowed: its keys are * (all), a publisher of Open VSX or an extension (publisher.name), its values true, false, stable (no pre-release) or the list of the versions allowed. The most precise key says it. An object that names anything allows only what it names. It adds to the lists of the settings and of the .escouade.yml files: an extension must be allowed by each. General › “Editor’s allowed extensions”, grayed; an extension outside the list is refused before any download, and an installed extension it leaves out is no longer loaded.
extensions.allowed.title: Editor’s allowed extensions

features.cost.description: The cost of turns, agents and tickets, and the cache temperature: true turns it on, false turns it off. Settings › Features › Cost, grayed.
features.cost.title: Cost feature

features.docs.description: The specification, decisions, documents and discussions: true turns it on, false turns it off (its tab, its MCP tools). Its pages are kept. Settings › Features › Docs space, grayed.
features.docs.title: Docs space feature

features.editor.description: Opening, editing and searching the project’s files: true turns it on, false turns it off (the editor view, Ctrl P, its language servers). Settings › Features › Editor, grayed.
features.editor.title: Editor feature

features.kanban.description: Tickets, the autopilot and ticket sources: true turns it on, false turns it off (its tab, its MCP tools, its autopilot). Its tickets are kept. Settings › Features › Kanban, grayed.
features.kanban.title: Kanban feature

features.overseer.description: The agent that drives every project: true turns it on, false turns it off (its screen, its shortcut, its MCP tools; it stops). Settings › Features › Overseer, grayed.
features.overseer.title: Overseer feature

features.scheduled.description: Tickets that come back at a set time: true turns it on, false turns it off (its tasks no longer run). It also goes with the Kanban. Settings › Features › Scheduled tasks, grayed.
features.scheduled.title: Scheduled tasks feature

features.stats.description: Activity and spending over time: true turns it on, false turns it off (its view). It has nothing to do with telemetry (telemetry.enabled). Settings › Features › Statistics, grayed.
features.stats.title: Statistics feature

features.voice.description: Dictation and spoken conversation: true turns it on, false turns it off (the microphone, its shortcut, the listening). Settings › Features › Voice, grayed.
features.voice.title: Voice feature

features.workflows.description: A project’s chains of agents and skills: true turns it on, false turns it off (its tab, its MCP tool, their reading). Settings › Features › Workflows, grayed.
features.workflows.title: Workflows feature

harnesses.allowed.description: The list of the harnesses agents may use, by their id (claude, codex, copilot, cursor, opencode, gemini…). An agent of a harness no longer allowed stops at the end of its turn. The harness of a project, an agent, a ticket: a harness not allowed is grayed and refused.
harnesses.allowed.title: Allowed harnesses

harnesses.allowedModels.description: A JSON object that gives, for each harness, the list of its allowed models. A harness absent from the object keeps all its models. An agent or a ticket on a model not allowed is refused at its start.
harnesses.allowedModels.title: Allowed models by harness

harnesses.maxEffort.description: The highest effort an agent may be given: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. The effort of the board’s agents brought down to this ceiling; a higher effort refused.
harnesses.maxEffort.title: Maximum effort

mcp.externalClients.description: What Claude outside Escouade (an outside MCP client) may do through Escouade’s MCP server: denied (nothing), readOnly (read only), allowed (everything). Escouade’s own agents are not concerned. An outside client refused at its connection (denied), or its tools that write refused (readOnly).
mcp.externalClients.title: Outside MCP clients

permissions.allowBypass.description: The mode where a harness asks nothing (bypassPermissions) is no longer allowed to any agent. Only the value false (0) is imposed. Settings › Agents › “Allow Bypass mode”, off and grayed; the Bypass mode refused everywhere.
permissions.allowBypass.title: Deny the Bypass mode

permissions.defaultMode.description: The mode of new agents: plan, default, acceptEdits or auto. It stays within the allowed modes: outside them, the nearest allowed one. Settings › Agents › “Default mode of agents”, grayed.
permissions.defaultMode.title: Default agent mode

permissions.modes.description: The list of the modes agents may take: plan, default, acceptEdits, auto, bypassPermissions. An agent in another mode ends its turn, then goes to the nearest allowed mode. The modes not allowed grayed in “Default mode of agents”, the board’s mode and an agent’s mode.
permissions.modes.title: Allowed permission modes

plugins.allowed.description: The list of the plugin ids that may be installed. Absent, all may. Installing a plugin outside the list is refused and said.
plugins.allowed.title: Allowed plugins

plugins.allowedOrigins.description: Where a plugin may be installed from: store-verified (the store, verified versions), store (the store, any version), team-store (the team’s store), git, folder (a folder), dev (a folder in development). Installing a plugin of another origin is refused and said.
plugins.allowedOrigins.title: Allowed plugin origins

plugins.denied.description: The list of the plugin ids that are never installed, even when allowed elsewhere. Installing a plugin of the list is refused and said.
plugins.denied.title: Denied plugins

plugins.projectSettings.description: A JSON object: its keys are plugin ids, its values the settings of project scope this device imposes in each project where the plugin is on (dev.acme.ci, level: strict). A simple setting only (text, number, boolean, choice): never a secret, a profile, a value imported nor a setting its author keeps off the files; such a setting is ignored and said. A team imposes its own by its file (plugins.id.key). Projects › Plugins, the setting grayed with the padlock and Imposed by this device’s policy; the plugin reads the imposed value.
plugins.projectSettings.title: Imposed plugin settings in each project

plugins.verifiedOnly.description: A version of the store without the “Verified by Escouade” seal is refused, at an install as at an update. Only the value true (1) is imposed. Plugins › “Install verified versions only”, on and grayed.
plugins.verifiedOnly.title: Install verified versions only

projects.deniedFiles.description: File patterns (the .gitignore way) agents neither read nor write, added to those of the projects. Read and kept; applied to the agents with a project’s fence of files (to come).
projects.deniedFiles.title: Denied file patterns

projects.forcePrivate.description: Every project is private: its agents see no other project, and no other project sees it. Only the value true (1) is imposed. “New projects are private” and each project’s “Private project”, on and grayed.
projects.forcePrivate.title: Private projects by default

projects.maxParallel.description: The most tickets “In progress” at once in each project’s Kanban, from 1 to 64. It lowers the machine’s bound (16 on a desktop, 64 on a server), never raises it; between this device and the team, the lower one holds. Settings › Kanban › “In parallel” goes no higher, the ceiling and where it comes from said under the setting; set_board refuses higher, and a Kanban set higher starts no more tickets than the ceiling.
projects.maxParallel.title: Ceiling of the tickets in parallel

proxy.authorities.description: The path of a .pem file of authorities trusted besides the system’s store (a corporate proxy’s root). Settings › Advanced › Network › “Extra certificate authorities”, grayed.
proxy.authorities.title: Certificate authorities file

proxy.denyInsecureTls.description: “Skip TLS certificate verification” is off and can no longer be turned on. Only the value true (1) is imposed. Settings › Advanced › Network › “Skip TLS certificate verification”, off and grayed.
proxy.denyInsecureTls.title: Deny skipping the TLS check

proxy.exclusions.description: The hosts reached without the proxy (NO_PROXY), one per line. Settings › Advanced › Network, the exclusions grayed.
proxy.exclusions.title: Proxy exclusions

proxy.url.description: The HTTP(S) proxy of the app, the plugins and the agents, for example http://proxy.example.com:3128. Settings › Advanced › Network, the proxy’s address grayed.
proxy.url.title: Proxy address

remoteControl.enabled.description: No agent is reachable from claude.ai. Only the value false (0) is imposed. “Remote control for all agents”, a project’s and an agent’s, off and grayed.
remoteControl.enabled.title: Deny the Remote Control

secrets.fileFallback.description: On a device without a system keychain, a plugin’s secret can no longer be kept in a file readable by its user alone: only the keychain keeps it. A file already chosen is no longer read; its secrets move to the keychain or are erased with it. Only the value false (0) is imposed. “Keep in a file only you can read” is no longer offered at a secret’s field, and Plugins › “Secrets kept in a file” bears the padlock.
secrets.fileFallback.title: Deny the file of the plugins’ secrets

servers.aggregateView.description: The “Everywhere” view shows only the numbers of a work server (of the allowed servers’ list, or any server without one), no text nor gesture. Set on a server, it holds for it. Only the value false (0) is imposed. “Everywhere” gives only the numbers of these spaces.
servers.aggregateView.title: Deny the aggregate view

servers.allowed.description: The addresses of the team servers and the servers in server mode the app may reach. Absent, all. A server outside the list is refused, with the reason.
servers.allowed.title: Allowed servers

servers.contentlessNotifications.description: The notifications from a work server (of the allowed servers’ list, or any server without one) say an agent is waiting, never what. Set on a server, it holds for it. Only the value true (1) is imposed. The notifications of these spaces carry no text.
servers.contentlessNotifications.title: Notifications without content

servers.personalSpace.description: Only the servers of the allowed servers’ list are added as spaces; without the list, none. This device stays a space. Only the value false (0) is imposed. A server outside the list is refused before any connection, with the reason.
servers.personalSpace.title: Deny the personal space

servers.phone.description: The phone’s WireGuard tunnel (ESC-567) does not turn on on this device nor on a server that receives it: no UDP port opened, nothing in the box, no API on the Tailscale address. The server mode through SSH stays allowed. Only the value false (0) is imposed. Settings › Phone, off and grayed; a tunnel that is on turns off at once.
servers.phone.title: Deny the access from the phone

servers.remoteApi.description: The core’s remote API (the server mode, the phone) does not turn on on this device: no other device drives it. Only the value false (0) is imposed. The remote API refused at its start and at each connection.
servers.remoteApi.title: Deny the remote API

team.fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the team expected on the team server: a team of another fingerprint is refused. Kept by the app; checked when joining the team (to come).
team.fingerprint.title: Team fingerprint

team.onlyThisServer.description: Only the team server the policy sets may be joined. Only the value true (1) is imposed. Another team server is refused, with the reason.
team.onlyThisServer.title: Refuse any other team server

team.server.description: The address of the company’s team server: the member only has to accept their invitation. Kept by the app; the screen to join the team will fill it in (to come).
team.server.title: Team server

telemetry.enabled.description: The anonymous statistics are no longer sent. Only the value false (0) is imposed. Settings › General › “Usage statistics”, off and grayed.
telemetry.enabled.title: Turn the usage statistics off

updates.automatic.description: A new version is offered, never installed by itself: the IT department deploys its own. Only the value false (0) is imposed. Settings › General › “Install updates automatically”, off and grayed.
updates.automatic.title: Turn automatic updates off

updates.channel.description: No beta version is offered. Only the value stable is imposed. Settings › General › “Receive beta versions”, off and grayed.
updates.channel.title: Stable channel only

voice.dictation.description: The dictation no longer starts. Only the value false (0) is imposed. Settings › Voice › Dictation, grayed; the dictation refused.
voice.dictation.title: Turn the dictation off

voice.onlineAllowed.description: The dictation and the conversation’s voice stay on the device (Whisper and Piper): no online service. Only the value false (0) is imposed. Settings › Voice, “Online” brought back to local (Whisper, Piper) and refused.
voice.onlineAllowed.title: Deny online voices

title: Escouade policies
